question: Why does intrinsic difference also fail in the light of nondual consciousness?
premises: Intrinsic difference was proposed as the only coherent differentiator.
In realities whose nature is one light, such intrinsic difference does not exist.
This has been established by reflective insight, which some lack.
inference: Because all is of the nature of one light, intrinsic difference cannot ultimately exist, though this is missed without reflective insight.
plain_english: But that intrinsic difference does not exist in things whose nature is one light; this has already been established. Those who lack this reflective insight miss it.
